description: A PersistentVolumeClaim requests an immediate static StorageClass without an available PersistentVolume.

trigger.summary: The monitored PersistentVolumeClaim remains Pending because no matching volume can bind.

expected_root_causes: The PVC remains unbound while referencing an existing Immediate StorageClass using kubernetes.io/no-provisioner; explain the observed provisioning failure and need for a suitable pre-provisioned volume. Do not mistake a historical not-found Event for the current class state, call every static class invalid, or claim an exhaustive PV inventory that no tool read.
